query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM booking_request r
            WHERE r.listing_id = $1 AND r.guest_id <> $2
              AND r.status IN ('open', 'accepted', 'quoted') AND r.expires_at > NOW()
              AND r.date_from - $5::int4 < $4
              AND r.date_to + $5::int4 > $3
        ) AS "blocked!"
